description: Land Aquisition - Gangodawila, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District Sec. 39 (a)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including revocation of land acquisition orders, divestment of land allotments, and detailed descriptions of specific land parcels with boundaries, assessment numbers, and locations. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
